summary: MaintService manages the maintenance and administration of 'Services' in the system, including their contacts and status (active/inactive). The screen enables authorized users to add, edit, inactivate, reactivate, and view service details, as well as manage associated contacts and agencies/sites. Workflow is governed by numerous business rules based on user roles, service state, and data integrity constraints.
purpose: To facilitate CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete/Inactivate/Reactivate) for Services, with contextual user permissions, validation, and business rules for service contacts and related agency/site management. Also provides user interaction for viewing glossary/help, handling errors/warnings, and managing service contact roles and status.

workflows.name: Add/Edit Service
steps: ServiceAddList and ContactList loaded for dropdowns
On Save/SaveAll, validation occurs (e.g. ServiceContact must be valid)
If PC tries to select HSPnet user as ServiceContact, error shown

workflows.name: Inactivate/Delete/Reactivate Service
steps: User clicks Inactivate/Delete/Reactivate on a service row
Service Delete or Reactivate methods called

workflows.name: Profile and Contact Management
steps: User clicks Profile or MaintUser icon
Opens new window with profile/user management
Profile icon highlights for recently accessed

workflows.name: Filtering and Refreshing View
steps: User selects filters (Agency, Site, Keyword, ShowInactive)

workflows.name: Error/Warning Handling
steps: Screen shows error/warning panels if needed
User can hide panels or respond to messages

business_rules: System Administrators can edit/view all services in their agency.
Local Administrators can edit services if allowed for their site.
Placement Coordinators can only edit Service Contact when not HSPnet user and only one active.
Users cannot edit services in their own agency unless they are receiving users, staff admin, or sysadmin.
If service has a destination and user is not sysadmin, cannot edit.
Show inactive services only if checkbox is checked.
ServiceContact must be valid (not '-1'); custom validation applied.
PC users cannot create ServiceContact with HSPnet user (error shown).
Grid disables edit fields if editing not allowed.
validations: CustomValidator on ddServiceContact: Must select valid Service Contact (not '-1').
If hdnSCEditableOnly == '1' and HSPnetUser is selected as Service Contact, error shown.
ValidationSummary shows errors in modal popup.
User permissions checked: ViewOnly, SystemAdministrator, ReceivingUser, StaffAdmin.
calculations: Add/Update Service: ServiceID, SiteID, ServiceCodeID pulled from controls and dropdowns.
Dropdown logic to select default values based on session and query params.
conditions: If Service is inactive or user lacks edit permissions, hide Edit buttons.
If Service Contact is not an HSPnet user and only one is active, Placement Coordinator can edit.
If service has destination and user is not sysadmin, editing disabled.
system_behavior: GridView supports dynamic row editing, adding, and deletion with custom controls.
Modal popup used for editing details.
Errors/warnings shown in panels, can be hidden by user.
Help/Glossary links open in new window with session query string.
Dropdowns dynamically filled based on agency/site selection and session.
dependencies: UserSession for permissions and session state.
Resources used for localized text in UI.
exceptions: If PC tries to select HSPnet user as ServiceContact when not allowed, error is shown.
If ServiceContact is invalid, custom validator triggers error.
